title: MXR triangular inversion for Qwen3.6 on Ascend

paper.title: Fast and Stable Triangular Inversion for Delta-Rule Linear Transformers

objective: Reproduce the official MXR/PTO mechanism faithfully on Ascend, prove multi-step numerical correctness and target-shape advantage, then obtain attributable matched end-to-end performance without quality regression through a plugin-owned monkeypatch.

goal_alignment.long_term: Deliver reproducible and portable Ascend performance benefit through a plugin-owned implementation without modifying upstream frameworks or images.
goal_alignment.medium_term: Build a complete evidence chain: official-method parity, CANN 9.1 compatibility, NPU numerical correctness, target-shape kernel timing, matched dense end-to-end A/B, and final quality.
goal_alignment.short_term: Resolve the pre-algorithm ACL initialization gate without touching physical NPU0-3, then execute the prepared one-shot NPU4 numerical and target-shape timing gate.

fixed_gates.stop_rule: Stop heavy integration and move to KVBuffer if the candidate has no clear target-shape kernel advantage or the attributable end-to-end gain is expected to remain below about 5 percent.

environment_blocker.error: aclInit 507899 Resource_Busy; torch_npu reports drv devId 0 invalid before any MXR code executes
environment_blocker.target_card_observation: Physical NPU4-7 were healthy, at idle-HBM baseline, and had no device-side process during each probe.
environment_blocker.kernel_evidence: The 2026-09-18T21:08:37Z post-release canary produced repeated Ascend UDA kernel errors: uda_occupy_dev_by_ns: Conflict open udevid (udevid=4; ns_id=0). npu-smi showed no process on any NPU and lsof showed no open target device file.
excluded_causes: missing host network or host cgroup namespace
logical index misuse after ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES remapping
missing ASCEND_DEVICE_ID index when ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES is set
environment_blocker.concurrent_state: The NPU0-3 serving container exited and all eight NPUs became process-free, but the same canary still failed. The only remaining running container is Maxon4ick_torch_910_dev: privileged, all host devices visible, no current NPU process, and an active interactive opencode process. It or stale driver namespace state may own the UDA reservation; causality is not yet proven.
environment_blocker.next_safe_branch: Obtain explicit approval to stop but not delete Maxon4ick_torch_910_dev, run exactly one non-privileged canary, and restart no foreign state automatically. If the conflict remains after the container is stopped, request an operator-approved driver namespace recovery; do not reset devices or restart driver services autonomously.

next_actions: Do not rerun npu-gate-v1 or any already-failed Docker mapping combination.
Resolve the ACL initialization gate with one evidence-backed canary; do not classify this environment failure as an MXR result.
After a canary succeeds, create a new immutable npu-gate-v2 root and run the prepared compile plus numerical gate; timing is admitted only if correctness passes.
If the gate passes, compare official staged, official megakernel, and the v0.23 baseline on the same target shape; preserve attribution between triangular inversion and full fusion.
Only integrate the winning path into vLLM after the target-shape gate passes.
